subject: english
question:
Fill in the blanks with the correct article.

______ aeroplane is the fastest means to travel to any part of ______ world.
solution:
The correct answer is '**4** i.e. an, the.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The article **"an"** is used before words that begin with a vowel sound (a, e, i, o, u).
 
• The article **"the"** is used to refer to something specific or unique.
 
• In the given sentence, **"an aeroplane"** is correct because "aeroplane" starts with a vowel sound.
 
• Additionally, **"the world"** is correct because "world" refers to a unique, specific entity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"An aeroplane is the fastest means to travel to any part of the world."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a, the"** is incorrect because "aeroplane" starts with a vowel sound, and "a" cannot be used before a vowel sound.
 
• **Option 3: "the, the"** is incorrect because "the" cannot be used before "aeroplane" in this general context.
 
• **Option 2: "an, a"** is incorrect because "a" cannot be used before "world," which is a unique entity.
